// Execute unchanged pinned FetchReservations using an in-memory SDK transport.
package crg

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/arm"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/policy"
)

type reservationCredential struct{ t *testing.T }

func (c reservationCredential) GetToken(ctx context.Context, o policy.TokenRequestOptions) (azcore.AccessToken, error) {
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(o.Scopes, []string{"https://management.core.windows.net//.default"}) {
		c.t.Fatal("unexpected reservation SDK audience")
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return azcore.AccessToken{}, err
	}
	return azcore.AccessToken{Token: "synthetic-reservation-canary", ExpiresOn: time.Now().Add(time.Hour)}, nil
}

type reservationPage struct {
	URL    string
	Status int
	Body   string
	Cancel bool
}
type reservationCase struct {
	Pages     []reservationPage
	Cancelled bool
}
type reservationResult struct {
	Entries          []ReservationEntry
	Failed, Panicked bool
	Requests         []string
}
type reservationTransport struct {
	t        *testing.T
	pages    []reservationPage
	requests []string
	cancel   context.CancelFunc
}

func (s *reservationTransport) Do(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	if err := r.Context().Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	i := len(s.requests)
	if i >= len(s.pages) || r.URL.String() != s.pages[i].URL || r.Method != "GET" || r.Body != nil || r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-reservation-canary" {
		s.t.Fatal("unexpected reservation SDK request", r.Method, r.URL.String())
	}
	s.requests = append(s.requests, r.URL.String())
	p := s.pages[i]
	if p.Cancel {
		s.cancel()
		return nil, context.Canceled
	}
	return &http.Response{StatusCode: p.Status, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}}, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(p.Body)), Request: r}, nil
}

type reservationNetworkTripwire struct{}

func (reservationNetworkTripwire) RoundTrip(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	panic("reservation capture attempted real network")
}
func TestRegionReservationCapture(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("REGION_RESERVATION_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing capture output")
	}
	oldTransport, oldClient := http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient
	http.DefaultTransport = reservationNetworkTripwire{}
	http.DefaultClient = &http.Client{Transport: reservationNetworkTripwire{}}
	defer func() { http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient = oldTransport, oldClient }()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("crg.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	const sourceBlob = "1ffb6e37cc1c21f6d8b5c9ce483f793387e0e6bc"
	h := sha1.Sum(append([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("blob %d\x00", len(raw))), raw...))
	if fmt.Sprintf("%x", h) != sourceBlob {
		t.Fatal("reservation source blob changed")
	}
	const sub = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
	const root = "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/" + sub
	const groups = root + "/providers/Microsoft.Compute/capacityReservationGroups?api-version=2024-11-01"
	list := func(group string) string {
		return root + "/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.Compute/capacityReservationGroups/" + group + "/capacityReservations?api-version=2024-11-01"
	}
	get := func(group, name string) string {
		return root + "/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.Compute/capacityReservationGroups/" + group + "/capacityReservations/" + name + "?%24expand=instanceView&api-version=2024-11-01"
	}
	group := func(name string) string {
		return `{"id":"/subscriptions/` + sub + `/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.Compute/capacityReservationGroups/` + name + `","name":"` + name + `","location":"EASTUS"}`
	}
	envelope := func(rows ...string) string { return `{"value":[` + strings.Join(rows, ",") + `]}` }
	summary := func(name string) string { return `{"name":"` + name + `"}` }
	row := func(name string, reserved, allocated int) string {
		vms := []string{}
		for i := 0; i < allocated; i++ {
			vms = append(vms, fmt.Sprintf(`{"id":"synthetic-vm-%d"}`, i))
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf(`{"name":%q,"location":"WESTUS","sku":{"name":"Standard_D2s_v5","capacity":%d},"properties":{"instanceView":{"utilizationInfo":{"virtualMachinesAllocated":[%s]}}}}`, name, reserved, strings.Join(vms, ","))
	}
	p := func(url, body string) reservationPage { return reservationPage{URL: url, Status: 200, Body: body} }
	single := func(body string) reservationCase {
		return reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(group("g"))), p(list("g"), envelope(summary("r"))), p(get("g", "r"), body)}}
	}
	cases := map[string]reservationCase{
		"idle": single(row("r", 4, 0)), "available": single(row("r", 4, 1)), "at": single(row("r", 4, 4)), "over": single(row("r", 4, 5)), "zero": single(row("r", 0, 0)), "negative": single(row("r", -1, 0)),
		"missing-utilization": single(`{"name":"r","sku":{"name":"Standard_D2s_v5","capacity":4}}`),
		"missing-capacity":    single(`{"name":"r","sku":{"name":"Standard_D2s_v5"},"properties":{"instanceView":{"utilizationInfo":{"virtualMachinesAllocated":[null]}}}}`),
		"missing-get-fields":  single(`{}`), "identity-conflict": single(row("returned-name", 4, 1)),
		"empty":                  {Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope())}},
		"skipped-groups":         {Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(`{}`, `{"name":"g"}`, `{"id":"x"}`))}},
		"skipped-summary":        {Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(group("g"))), p(list("g"), envelope(`{}`))}},
		"malformed-group-id":     {Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(`{"id":"malformed","name":"g"}`))}},
		"null-group":             {Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(`null`))}},
		"null-summary":           {Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(group("g"))), p(list("g"), envelope(`null`))}},
		"missing-group-location": {Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(`{"id":"/subscriptions/`+sub+`/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.Compute/capacityReservationGroups/g","name":"g"}`)), p(list("g"), envelope(summary("r"))), p(get("g", "r"), row("r", 4, 1))}},
		"cancelled":              {Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope())}, Cancelled: true},
	}
	errorBody := `{"error":{"code":"SyntheticReservationError","message":"synthetic"}}`
	for _, status := range []int{403, 404} {
		cases[fmt.Sprintf("group-http%d", status)] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{{URL: groups, Status: status, Body: errorBody}}}
		cases[fmt.Sprintf("list-http%d", status)] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(group("g"), group("other"))), {URL: list("g"), Status: status, Body: errorBody}, p(list("other"), envelope(summary("r"))), p(get("other", "r"), row("r", 4, 1))}}
		cases[fmt.Sprintf("get-http%d", status)] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(group("g"))), p(list("g"), envelope(summary("bad"), summary("r"))), {URL: get("g", "bad"), Status: status, Body: errorBody}, p(get("g", "r"), row("r", 4, 1))}}
	}
	cases["group-malformed"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, `{"value":`)}}
	cases["list-malformed"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(group("g"))), p(list("g"), `{"value":`)}}
	cases["get-malformed"] = single(`{"name":`)
	nextGroup := root + "/providers/Microsoft.Compute/capacityReservationGroups?%24skiptoken=second&api-version=2024-11-01"
	nextList := root + "/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.Compute/capacityReservationGroups/g/capacityReservations?%24skiptoken=second&api-version=2024-11-01"
	withNext := func(body, next string) string {
		return strings.TrimSuffix(body, "}") + `,"nextLink":` + fmt.Sprintf("%q", next) + `}`
	}
	firstGroup := p(groups, withNext(envelope(group("g")), nextGroup))
	firstList := p(list("g"), envelope(summary("r")))
	firstGet := p(get("g", "r"), row("r", 4, 1))
	cases["group-paged"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{firstGroup, firstList, firstGet, p(nextGroup, envelope(group("other"))), p(list("other"), envelope())}}
	cases["later-group-http403"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{firstGroup, firstList, firstGet, {URL: nextGroup, Status: 403, Body: errorBody}}}
	cases["later-group-malformed"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{firstGroup, firstList, firstGet, p(nextGroup, `{"value":`)}}
	initialGroups := p(groups, envelope(group("g"), group("other")))
	pagedList := p(list("g"), withNext(envelope(summary("r")), nextList))
	otherEmpty := p(list("other"), envelope())
	cases["list-paged"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{initialGroups, pagedList, firstGet, p(nextList, envelope(summary("second"))), p(get("g", "second"), row("second", 4, 4)), otherEmpty}}
	cases["later-list-http403"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{initialGroups, pagedList, firstGet, {URL: nextList, Status: 403, Body: errorBody}, otherEmpty}}
	cases["later-list-malformed"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{initialGroups, pagedList, firstGet, p(nextList, `{"value":`), otherEmpty}}
	cases["cancel-list"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(group("g"))), {URL: list("g"), Cancel: true}}}
	cases["cancel-get"] = reservationCase{Pages: []reservationPage{p(groups, envelope(group("g"))), p(list("g"), envelope(summary("r"))), {URL: get("g", "r"), Cancel: true}}}
	results := map[string]reservationResult{}
	for name, fixture := range cases {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		if fixture.Cancelled {
			cancel()
		}
		transport := &reservationTransport{t: t, pages: fixture.Pages, requests: []string{}, cancel: cancel}
		opts := &arm.ClientOptions{ClientOptions: policy.ClientOptions{Transport: transport, Retry: policy.RetryOptions{MaxRetries: -1}}, DisableRPRegistration: true}
		result := reservationResult{}
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if recover() != nil {
					result.Panicked = true
				}
			}()
			var e error
			result.Entries, e = FetchReservations(ctx, reservationCredential{t}, opts, sub, "Synthetic Subscription")
			result.Failed = e != nil
		}()
		cancel()
		expected := len(fixture.Pages)
		if fixture.Cancelled {
			expected = 0
		}
		if len(transport.requests) != expected {
			t.Fatal("incomplete reservation source request sequence", name)
		}
		if result.Panicked != (name == "null-group" || name == "null-summary") {
			t.Fatal("unexpected reservation source panic", name)
		}
		result.Requests = transport.requests
		results[name] = result
	}
	write := func(name string, v any) {
		raw, e := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = os.MkdirAll(out, 0700); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, name), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	write("source-reservation-inputs.json", struct {
		SourceBlob, SDKModule string
		DisableRPRegistration bool
		MaxRetries            int
		Cases                 map[string]reservationCase
	}{sourceBlob, "github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/compute/armcompute/v6 v6.4.0", true, -1, cases})
	write("source-reservation-outputs.json", results)
}
